title: St Mary's Chapel at Glastonbury Abbey keeps the original chapel's diameter
summary: Randall Carlson tells of St Mary's Chapel at Glastonbury Abbey keeps the original chapel's diameter, about 1st century AD to 10th century at Glastonbury Abbey, England, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Mary's Chapel. Its width of 39.6 6 feet it is said preserves the diameter of the original chapel.
